g.text: issuePrescription(consultationID, items): validate prescribing authority and all items, then commit
searchAvailability(...); requestFollowUp(...): derive patient from consultation, reuse booking + resource validation
Audit/commit failure discards consultation, associations and completion together.
Audit records contain no clinical content. Optional operation failures never undo c.
Arrival and clinical workflow are design-only in this scheduling PoC.
